### `access.actionproof`

- 类型：普通表；所有者：`shopmigration`；大小：40 kB；估算行数：-1；RLS：启用（FORCE）

#### 字段

|   # | 字段                     | 类型                       | 允许 NULL | Identity | Generated | 默认值              | 字段含义                                             |
| --: | ------------------------ | -------------------------- | --------: | -------- | --------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
|   1 | `id`                     | `uuid`                     |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 本记录唯一标识                                       |
|   2 | `token_hash`             | `bytea`                    |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 令牌原文的哈希摘要                                   |

|   4 | `resource_id`            | `text`                     |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 资源标识                                             |
|   5 | `request_hash`           | `character(64)`            |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 请求的哈希摘要                                       |
|   6 | `expected_version`       | `bigint`                   |        是 | —        | —         | —                   | 预期版本号                                           |
|   7 | `target`                 | `text`                     |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 操作目标                                             |
|   8 | `scope_id`               | `text`                     |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 权限控制与数据隔离作用域标识                         |
|   9 | `maker_membership_id`    | `text`                     |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 发起人成员关系标识；外键关联 `access.membership(id)` |
|  10 | `checker_membership_id`  | `text`                     |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 复核人成员关系标识；外键关联 `access.membership(id)` |
|  11 | `checker_access_version` | `bigint`                   |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 复核人的权限版本号                                   |
|  12 | `permission_code`        | `text`                     |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 权限编码；外键关联 `access.permission(code)`         |
|  13 | `expires_at`             | `timestamp with time zone` |        否 | —        | —         | —                   | 过期时间                                             |
|  14 | `consumed_at`            | `timestamp with time zone` |        是 | —        | —         | —                   | 使用时间                                             |
|  15 | `created_at`             | `timestamp with time zone` |        否 | —        | —         | `clock_timestamp()` | 记录创建时间                                         |

| 类型        | 名称                                       | 定义                                                                                  | 可延迟 | 初始延迟 | 已验证 |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -----: | -------: | -----: |
| PRIMARY KEY | `actionproof_pkey`                         | PRIMARY KEY (id)                                                                      |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| UNIQUE      | `actionproof_token_hash_key`               | UNIQUE (token_hash)                                                                   |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| FOREIGN KEY | `actionproof_checker_membership_id_fkey`   | FOREIGN KEY (checker_membership_id) REFERENCES access.membership(id)                  |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| FOREIGN KEY | `actionproof_maker_membership_id_fkey`     | FOREIGN KEY (maker_membership_id) REFERENCES access.membership(id)                    |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| FOREIGN KEY | `actionproof_operation_id_fkey`            | FOREIGN KEY (operation_id) REFERENCES runtime.operation(id)                           |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| FOREIGN KEY | `actionproof_permission_code_fkey`         | FOREIGN KEY (permission_code) REFERENCES access.permission(code)                      |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| CHECK       | `actionproof_check`                        | CHECK (maker_membership_id <> checker_membership_id)                                  |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| CHECK       | `actionproof_check1`                       | CHECK (expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= (created_at + '00:15:00'::interval)) |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| CHECK       | `actionproof_check2`                       | CHECK (consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at >= created_at)                              |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| CHECK       | `actionproof_checker_access_version_check` | CHECK (checker_access_version > 0)                                                    |     否 |       否 |     是 |
| CHECK       | `actionproof_target_check`                 | CHECK (target = ANY (ARRAY['console'::text, 'storefront'::text]))                     |     否 |       否 |     是 |

| `actionproof_token_hash_key` |   否 |   是 |   是 | CREATE UNIQUE INDEX actionproof_token_hash_key ON access.actionproof USING btree (token_hash)                                         |
| `access_actionproof_checker` |   否 |   否 |   是 | CREATE INDEX access_actionproof_checker ON access.actionproof USING btree (checker_membership_id, checker_access_version, expires_at) |
| `access_actionproof_expiry`  |   否 |   否 |   是 | CREATE INDEX access_actionproof_expiry ON access.actionproof USING btree (expires_at, id) WHERE (consumed_at IS NULL)                 |

## 4. 视图

1 个非系统视图：

### `benefit.balance`

- 类型：普通视图

```sql
 SELECT account.id AS account_id,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN entry.side = 'credit'::text THEN entry.amount_minor
            ELSE - entry.amount_minor
        END) FILTER (WHERE journal.state = 'posted'::text), 0::numeric)::bigint AS balance_minor
   FROM benefit.account account
     LEFT JOIN finance.entry entry ON entry.account_id = account.finance_account_id
     LEFT JOIN finance.journal journal ON journal.id = entry.journal_id
  GROUP BY account.id;
```
